newsitem.title: FAROE ISLANDS: SOCCER-TEN-MAN FAROES WIN SECOND WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEN-MAN FAROES WIN SECOND WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: The Faroe Islands, reduced to 10 men from the 47th minute, completed a World Cup double over Malta when they beat them 2-1 on Sunday.
The Faroes had scored their first ever World Cup victory when they beat Malta by the same score in a group six tie in April.
The Faroese dominated the first half, scoring through Uni Arge and Todi Jonsson in the sixth and 41st minutes respectively.

But two minutes after the break their captain Jan Dam was sent off for a handling offence and Gilbert Agius scored from the resulting penalty, sparking a short but unproductive period of dominance by the visitors.
Seven minutes from the end Malta were also reduced to 10 men when Lawrence Attard, a first half substitute for Darren Debono, was sent off after collecting two yellow cards.
